Featuring the unique ingredient Thiamadol®, it reduces all types of dark spots and prevents their re-appearance in 2 weeks.</div><span class="legal-label cp-text-s">NART: 83505-09910-27</span></div><div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Read more about our product</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text">Pigmentation day cream with SPF 30 Melanin is a natural pigment that gives colour to skin. Exposure to <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/about-skin/basic-skin-knowledge/sun-and-the-skin" target="">sunlight</a>, hormonal influences and ageing can cause an increase in melanin production and trigger hyperpigmentation. <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/uneven-skin/hyperpigmentation" target="">Hyperpigmentation</a> appears as dark patches and <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/about-skin/indications/age-spots" target="">age spots</a> (also known as <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/about-skin/indications/age-spots" target="">sun spots</a>) that make skin look uneven. Eucerin Anti-Pigment Day SPF 30 contains <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/t/thiamidol" target="">Thiamidol</a>, an effective and patented ingredient that acts at the root cause of hyperpigmentation by reducing melanin production. It is clinically and dermatologically proven to reduce dark spots and prevent their re-appearance. First results are visible after two weeks and improve continuously with regular use. With UVA and UVB filters (SPF 30) the moisturising day cream offers effective protection from the sun and reduces the chances of skin developing sun-induced pigment spots. Skin appears even and radiant.</div></div></div></div></div><template id="P:2"></template></div></div><div class="media"><picture loading="lazy"><source srcSet="https://images-1.eucerin.com/~/media/eucerin%20relaunch%20media/media-center-items/9/d/7/120290db9f404cfd81fe4c6789deccdf-screen.jpg?db=web&mw=945&hash=96349a553f4273a18ca272ee763faf42" media="(min-width: 1024px)"/><source srcSet="https://images-1.eucerin.com/~/media/eucerin%20relaunch%20media/media-center-items/9/d/7/120290db9f404cfd81fe4c6789deccdf-screen.jpg?db=web&mw=1023&hash=0f7029720a2b75ae196f33314d199368" media="(max-width: 1023px)"/><img loading="lazy" srcSet="https://images-1.eucerin.com/~/media/eucerin%20relaunch%20media/media-center-items/9/d/7/120290db9f404cfd81fe4c6789deccdf-screen.jpg?db=web&hash=b92c8d785fec6a09c8083dc5d8a72687" alt=""/></picture></div></div></section><section class="pdp-main-findings-section cp-container uk-section"><div class="cp-row cp-row-center"><div class="cp-section-content"><div class="title-container"><p class="title hdl-3">Main findings</p><div class="tooltip-wrapper" data-module="Tooltip"><span class="tooltip-info-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="12" height="13" viewBox="0 0 12 13" fill="none"><rect y="0.5" width="12" height="12" rx="6" fill="#223341"></rect><path d="M5.25 4.26066C5.25 4.04739 5.31164 3.8673 5.43493 3.72038C5.56279 3.57346 5.75 3.5 5.99658 3.5C6.23858 3.5 6.42352 3.57346 6.55137 3.72038C6.68379 3.8673 6.75 4.04739 6.75 4.26066C6.75 4.46446 6.68379 4.63981 6.55137 4.78673C6.42352 4.92891 6.23858 5 5.99658 5C5.75 5 5.56279 4.92891 5.43493 4.78673C5.31164 4.63981 5.25 4.46446 5.25 4.26066Z" fill="white"></path><path d="M6.5 6.5V10.5H5.5V6.5H6.5Z" fill="white"></path></svg></span><div class="tooltip-content cp-text-s uk-drop uk-drop-top-left">*Expert grading by dermatologists on 457 patients using regime ( Serum, Day, Night each once daily) over 12 weeks, study in 11 European countries.

Experts questionnaire on 572 patients</div></div></div><div class="cp-row"><div class="col-6"><div class="percentage cp-text">97%</div><div class="text cp-text">Spot reduction success<sup> <!-- -->1</sup></div></div><div class="col-6"><div class="percentage cp-text">98%</div><div class="text cp-text">Confirm spot reduction success<sup> <!-- -->2</sup></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="pdp-ingredients-section cp-container uk-section" id="pdp-ingredients-section" data-anchor-navigation-title="pdp-ingredients-section"><div class="description"><h3 class="hdl-3">Clinical Formula</h3> <div class="key-ingredients grid-mode"><div class="key-ingredients-grid cp-row"><div class="key-ingredient-item col-6"><div class="key-ingredients__content"><div class="hdl-4">Thiamidol</div><div class="cp-text-m"><p>Thiamidol is a patented ingredient, known to fight hyperpigmentation acting at its root cause. It works by inhibiting the human tyrosinase, the key enzyme in melanin production. Hyperpigmentation can be the result of different causes, e.g. sun-induced dark spots, post-blemish marks or age spots. Key benefits are:
</p>
<p>Reduction of Hyperpigmentation: By effectively inhibiting tyrosinase, Thiamidol decreases melanin synthesis, leading to a visible reduction in dark spots and an even skin tone.
</p>
<p>Works on all skin types: Thiamidol is dermatologically tested and suitable for all skin types, including dry, oily, combination, normal and sensitive skin. It works for skin of any ethnicity or age and thus is effective on all skin types and tones.
</p>
<p>Fights post-blemish marks: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation happens when skin is inflamed or injured, for example because of blemishes. The impacted area is left darkened and hyperpigmented despite having otherwise healed. Thiamidol addresses these areas resulting in an even skin tone.</p></div><a class="key-ingredients__link cp-link-s" href="/our-research/ingredients/t/thiamidol">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="key-ingredient-item col-6"><div class="key-ingredients__content"><div class="hdl-4">Licochalcone A</div><div class="cp-text-m"><p>Licochalcone A is a powerful antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and skin-soothing ingredient. It is derived from the root of the Chinese Licorice plant (Glycyrrhiza Inflata) which uses natural compounds to protect its cells from excessive sunlight. When used in skincare products, Licochalcone A works to reduce inflammation and neutralise free radicals that negatively influence skin cells and accelerate the ageing process. It helps to protect the deeper epidermal skin layers from sun-induced effects.</p></div><a class="key-ingredients__link cp-link-s" href="/our-research/ingredients/l/licochalcone%20a">Learn More</a></div></div></div></div><div class="pdp-ingredients-section__link-container"><div class="pdp-ingredients-section__main-link btn secondary-btn"> <!-- -->View all</div></div></div></section><section class="uk-section cp-container faq-section"><div class="cp-row cp-row-center"><div class="cp-section-content"><div class="title hdl-3">FAQ</div><div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Is Eucerin Anti-Pigment Day SPF 30 suitable for skin with age spots?</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p>Yes. Eucerin Anti-Pigment Day SPF 30 can be used to reduce many of the different types of hyperpigmentation which include <a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/about-skin/indications/age-spots">age spots</a> (also known as <a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/about-skin/indications/age-spots">sun spots</a>). And, with SPF 30, it also protects skin from the sun helping to reduce further sun-induced pigmentation issues. For optimal results we recommend that you use it in combination with other products in the <a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/products/anti-pigment">Eucerin Anti-Pigment range</a>.<br />
<br />
You can find out more about the different types of hyperpigmentation and what causes them in <a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/skin-concerns/uneven-skin">Hyperpigmentation.</a></p></div></div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Why does Eucerin Anti-Pigment Day SPF 30 contain UVA and UVB protection?</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p>Even on cloudy days the sun’s rays can cause <a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/skin-concerns/uneven-skin">hyperpigmentation</a>, <a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/skin-concerns/sun-protection/photoaging">photoaging</a> (the word used to describe premature skin ageing caused by the sun) and DNA damage. Find out more in <a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/about-skin/basic-skin-knowledge/sun-and-the-skin">how sun affects skin</a>. Our day cream contains both UVA and UVB filters to give skin the daily protection it needs.<br />
<br />
If you are looking for a product where the primary focus is on sun protection, Eucerin’s superior <a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/products/sun-protection">sun protection range</a> includes both high and very high SPF products that are specially formulated to address different skin concerns such as ageing skin, dry skin, oily/acne prone skin and sun allergies.
